hook: Most people who stay broke aren't lazy. They work hard and pay their bills, and the money still disappears every month. In this video I go through 25 quiet habits that keep people broke, from three angles: the numbers you can measure, the psychology that keeps you spending without noticing, and the playbook of simple systems that turn it around.
